kit: gor prepare Mac runtime - nunif iw3 synthesis runners (190w W3 tiers, CoreML fp16)
status: CONVERTED on Linux (coremltools 9.0), NEVER EXECUTED - macOS-only; verify each package vs its *_fixture.npz (torch fp32, seeded) before first use
source_weights: gor-kit-nunif-v2.tar (gorav gor-kit-2026-11-09, sha 0dbfb58d...), upstream nunif release 0.0.0, MIT; owner-private Mac build only (190w W1)

convention.warp_models: input x = [1,3,H,W] = (depth, divergence_feature, convergence_feature) per iw3.backward_warp.make_input_tensor(c=None); divergence/convergence are baked into feature channels runner-side, NOT model inputs. Outputs used per iw3.backward_warp.apply_divergence_nn_delta_weight: delta (grid delta, x2 for sym), layer_weight, hole_mask_logits (mask model only). layer_weight is interpolated to frame size runner-side (upstream F.interpolate bilinear align_corners=True antialias=True).
convention.inpaint_models: inputs x [B,3,H,W] masked RGB + mask [B,1,H,W] AFTER upstream preprocess (hole closing/dilation + SeparableGaussian blur stay runner-side, mirroring iw3 LightInpaintV1.preprocess / LightVideoInpaintV1.preprocess); converted boundary is model.forward(x, mask, skip_i2i_offset=True). Video model B=12 (SEQ_LEN) per window; overlap/padding across windows is runner-side (iw3.base_inpaint BaseVideoInpaint, default overlap 3+3).
convention.padding: inputs must be pre-padded (replication) so H,W are multiples of 96; models always pad one block internally and crop (trace converted with slice-crop, numerically identical)
convention.shapes_note: row_flow/mask_mlbw/light_inpaint converted at 768x1344 (720p + pad). light_video_inpaint converted at 288x480: this Linux box (2GB) OOMs tracing it larger. Mac-side re-conversion at production res: tools/depth_analysis/nunif_convert.py --shape (script in repo); 288x480 package is for runner-wiring + parity-harness bring-up, NOT final T1 quality.
